text:
Noah: Kickoff: Greenroom partner plan draft. Objective: 4 integrated partners in 9 weeks, clear incentive tiers and an automated triage-to-backlog flow.
Iris: Love it. What are the incentive bands? Keep finance happy and ops predictable.
Noah: Proposal: Light = early access + public docs; Standard = $3k credits + 4 office hours; Platinum = $12k credits + 20 SRE hours + roadmap slot + anonymized case study. Platinum needs a 6-week stability window.
Sam: For private/VPC installs, Platinum should include an on-prem install stipend ($6k) and mandatory runbook sign-off. Also require a 30d commit to the pilot.
Lena: Feedback capture: single canonical tag in console `greenroom:report` and an intake that asks reproducible, severity (1-5), biz_impact, and suggested_fix. dp-bot should create a triage card and optional GH issue.
dp-bot: Intake form live: https://internal.redwood/greenroom (auto-tag: greenroom:report) :white_check_mark:
Noah: Quick scoring sketch — simple and explainable:
```
score = (3 if reproducible else 0) + (2 if severity >=4 else 1 if severity==3 else 0) + (2 if biz_impact == 'high' else 1 if biz_impact == 'medium' else 0)
```
Map raw score to priority: 6-7 => P0, 4-5 => P1, <=3 => backlog/watch. Multiply by tier_weight: Platinum x1.25, Standard x1.1, Light x1.0.
Iris: Add security override: any intake marked PHI/PCI auto-escalates to Sec for fast review and becomes urgent regardless of score.
Sam: Onboarding checklist: day0 access + API keys, day1 dataset ingest + eval prompts, day4 baseline metrics, day7 e2e smoke. Platinum gets extended stability checks through week6. I'll draft templates.
Kiran: Success gating to keep partner active: by day30 either >=10 valid calls/day OR consistent daily evals with quality within 3% of baseline. Otherwise offer downgrade to Standard/Light.
Lena: Infra gating: staging SLOs sustained 72h, partner e2e tests green, and no quality regression >1.5% vs baseline. If fail, 3-day hotfix window then re-evaluate.
Noah: Actions: @Sam - onboarding templates; @Iris - wire security override; @Kiran - partner gating doc; @Noah - finalize incentives & publish intake. Reconvene Tue to approve.
Iris: I'll add the KMS checkbox + retention caps tonight.
Sam: Templates posted by EOD tomorrow.
Kiran: Gating doc draft tomorrow morning.
Noah: Thanks team. Keep cohorts small and prioritize signal over volume. :seedling:
